0-5 - Metric the encoder tunes for; 5 favours retaining film grain
0.0-8.0 (default 1.0) - Psychovisual rate distortion, biasing towards preserving texture
0-3 - Bias towards sharpness and detail retention, at the possible cost of more blocking
0-7 (default 1) - Deblocking sharpness; higher keeps more detail, lower smooths more
0-1 (default 1 in this build) - Sharper transform decisions
32 or 64 - Caps the largest transform size the encoder may pick
0-1 (default 0) - Psychovisual tuning using an alternative SSIM calculation
1-4 (default 2) - Strength of the variance-based bit allocation for AQ modes 0 and 2
1-8 (default 5) - How selective variance boost is when boosting a superblock; lower is more selective
0-3 (default 0) - Variance boost curve, each with different bit allocation and look
0-100 - Shifts QP by average frame luminance, helping dark scenes
0-15 (default 8 in this build) - Lowest chroma quantisation matrix level

-1 to 2 (default -1, follows the preset) - How much of the mode decision runs at high bit depth. 0: all 8-bit, 1: all 10-bit, 2: hybrid. 10-bit only does anything on a 10-bit input, i.e. a 10 bit Color Format
0-2 - Deblocking loop filter; 2 is the more accurate variant
0-4 (default 1) - Temporal filtering strength on keyframes only
0-4 (default 2) - Backs CDEF and restoration off where the source is noisy
1-30 - CDEF strength; lower sharpens, higher smooths
0-200 - Synthesises grain at this strength (this build's own grain control, separate from the Grain Synthesis boxes)
-1 to 200 (default -1) - Chroma grain strength; -1 tracks about 60% of --noise
0-1 (default 0) - Derive chroma grain from the luma plane
-1 to 13 (default -1) - Grain size; -1 picks one from the resolution
0-4 (default 1) - Lifts AC coefficients in finely textured areas
0-1 - Varies film grain block size with resolution
